full_judgment: 13. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and the material evidence on record, we are of the view that the finding of forgery is absolutely based on presumption, supposition, hypothesis and surmise and there is no evidence to show that the resolution dated 21.5.92 was forged and fabricated by the present appellant after he took it back from the Tribunal on 2.12.93. As such we find that the judgment of the Bar Council Tribunal, so far it relates to the present appellant, cannot be sustained in law.
